title: The Responsibilities of the Poles (Aqtaab) and Unexpected Events in Space
body:
Fatihah.
Dastoor yaa rijaalAllah, madad.
(Mawlana stands.) La ilaaha illa-Llah, la ilaaha illa Llah, la ilaaha illa-Llah la ilaha illa-Llah. Subhaanahu wa
ta`ala, yaa Rabbana salli was sallam Sayyidi ‘l-awwaleen wa ‘l-akhireen, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)
O our Lord, our Creator! You are granting us such an honor, no one knows its real value. It is a rare honor
that we have been granted, laka 'l-hamd yaa Rabbana yaa Rabbi ‘l `aalameen, yaa Rabbana, yaa Rabbi ‘l`aalameen. (Mawlana sits.)
We are sending through our Grandshaykh (q), who is responsible for every happening among Mankind in
this world. There is another one who is responsible for the world of animals, another one looking after every
plant that is growing on Earth, another one responsible for oceans, another one responsible for rain and
snow and everything happening in the skies closer to our planet. There is another one who is responsible for
making the planet on its real direction, as it has been ordered to reach to that point. There are servants who
are looking after all beings and happenings on this planet through every creature: animal world, plant world,
rain and snow. Yes, all of them are appointed through the heavenly assembly, only their position is different.
They are commanding not just one planet, but for our level, many planets are going to be their responsibility.

That is the beginning for our holy meeting.
O People, as-salaamu `alaykum. O listeners, try to be a listener for our level, what is it that is going to
happen, what has just happened. Knowledge gives you honor, and when it is getting wider, your
understanding going to be on such a way, not stopping.
As-salaamu `alaykum, all Mankind! If you are listening, just gaining, if you are not listening, losing. But we
have been sent here for reaching more and more enlightened positions of what is happening and also what is
going to happen on and around this planet. People are thinking as it shows from far away, that our planet is
like a football. They are looking and seeing nothing, as their simple looking is showing them this planet only
as a planet, yes. But they are not knowing which things are surrounding it and how this huge planet is being
controlled. The control of this planet is so sensitive, so fine.
Countless authorities around this planet are responsible for controlling this. Therefore, its moving is never
going in a wrong way or coming out, just under the direction and control of special beings who are directing
it. Those looking after it must be from Mankind, or from jinns under the control of Mankind, the protectors
of this planet. And above that are angels who have a high responsibility for this planet; and having their
directions are therefore, never losing anyone and know about their actions or missions. People are looking
and thinking about a globe running on its orbit. Yes, it is going around in an orbit and at the same time
moving around the sun, which is responsible for every planet running around its orbit, and each one is having
a different speed, some of them running slowly, some of them with much more speed, and some running
most speedily.
It is a system that people are only looking at and seeing but not thinking about. Countless, countless positions
for this, we are saying “solar system” and it is not yet clear what in solar system is from other moving globes.
They are knowing seven or nine planets orbit around the sun, because the sun is sultan, and sultan can’t be
only for seven or eight or nine globes, no. But with our physical ability, it is impossible to see, to look at those
ones. And there is so (great) darkness on the orbit of the sun; dark darkness. Only what is granted to people
to know is seven or nine planets. Others, are running also with solar system, that no one is knowing the real
measure of the solar system, from where it is beginning or up to where it is reaching. That muharrik (moving)
no one knows how many orbits are running around the sun, but our looking power can’t reach. Only those

people whom they have been granted an authority from heavenly ones have granted such an authority for
looking.
Therefore, people now looking and they are saying seven or eight or nine (planets). That is the last limit of
their understanding, yet they are looking, looking, looking. We are looking and seeing according to our
physical being. The authority is reaching to that one, but beyond that, the sun is sultan. The sultan can’t only
be for seven stars, no. Running under every star or planet are countless planets, globes and global systems
but we can’t carry this if it is going to be open, •••••••• ••••••• •••••• - fa-buhitalladhee kafr (Thereupon he who
was bent on denying the truth remained dumbfounded, 2:258) astonishing. They are making us to say such a
things, to make Man’s understanding wider. For what? For the coming days when such unexpected events are
going to appear and be seen through space. And the solar system is going to be only as a spot and going down
also, becoming smaller, smaller, smaller and then finishing and entering into Power Oceans, going there as a
raindrop and when reaching the oceans, disappearing, finishing. And for everything there is a beginning and
ending, and every creation shows people `adhaamatu ‘l-Khaaliq, the greatness of the Creator.
O People, we are wasting our grant on heavenly levels, a grant from their Lord for understanding. Don’t think
that understanding is going to stop, no! Always getting more and more and more because the Lord of
Heavens is enlightening His friends, His awliya, to know, to taste, to be happy, to be thankful, to be in
pleasure and to be in endless lights from the Divine Presence. Therefore, Allah Almighty is raising His
awliyaa that they may look and see, as much as the Lord of Heavens makes them to know, to hear, to see, and
to understand.
O Salafi `ulama, what do you say now? As much as the Lord of Heavens is giving His elected and selected
servants, His chosen ones. You are saying that you are `ulama, but I am saying something on this point to
you and it is so well known, but no one is opening any page on this point in order to teach people. Sayyidina
`Umar, Allah's praisings on him, was on the minbar addressing people for khutbatu ‘l-jumu`ah. This is a
famous happening. Do you know it? Yes, you know it. Why are you not remarking on such a special being,
one who has been granted a special honor in Islam, Sayyidina `Umar? He was addressing the taabi`i ‘tTaabi`een and suddenly, his out-looking (appearance) just changed and the Sahaaba were surprised that it
was not the same `Umar they were looking at, but he had just been changed and dressed by some heavenly
appearance, heavenly lights. They were looking to see what was happening and in the khutbah he was

shouting, saying, Yaa Saariya ‘t-al-jabal! “O Saariya! Take care behind the mountain!” SubhaanAllah, like a
person looking with a huge telescope, but it wasn’t a telescope, he was just seeing Saariyah (commander of
the Muslim army) and saying, Saariya ‘t-al-jabal, Saariya ‘t-al-jabal, Saariya ‘t-al-jabal.
What does it prove was happening? I am asking Salafi `ulama, because they are saying, “Our level is above all
`ulama.” I am asking, is this information not true? (What means khabar, ‘news’? I am not an Arab like you...)
“Saariyah, if you are in distance, take your care behind mountain!" That one was seeing Sayyidina `Umar’s
warning. What is important is, is this something that never happened? It happened in front of hundreds of
Sahaaba (r)!!!
This proves everyone may reach to that point, to Lord of Creation; on Earth they may see heavens! Don’t say
can’t be! We are saying through the Holy Qur’an as shaahid, witness, as they have such a power for looking so
far away through distances, we have such an ability to hear from heavens, to look and to listen also!! That is
lawh al-bushra. Sayyidina `Umar was on the first level of awliyaa and the power of the awliyaa coming after
them is not on the same level that the Sahaaba (r) were granted. How did they reach it? They were taking it
from the center of power (Mawlana stands), from Sayyidina Muhammad (s).
O People! Try to learn and through your short life try to reach something that will be forever for you! You are
wasting your life doing that which will never giving you anything, it will finish. Asking for everything you are
reaching in dunya, “Where is it? We wasted our whole life to reach that!? Where is it?” And the angels will
answer back, “Look in the WC (bathroom) and you shall find it there.” And those who are working for
heavens, Allah Almighty will grant them such an honor you can’t imagine it!
Therefore, I am shouting and they are making me to shout. I know nothing, but I am coming to say, “O
People, don’t waste your lives over such activities through dunya, the result you will find through WC.” I am
only a muhazzir, one who is warning. May Allah forgive us.
O People! Think on it. Don’t kill each other; that is not your honor, to kill. The Lord of Heavens (swt) says,
“Don’t kill, but make people to live.”
O our Lord! Send us such a high-quality one to teach us, to show us realities, real positions about ourselves,
that make us to reach Your heavenly grant. O People, say, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah, astaghfirullah,

astaghfirullah, Yaa Rabbee! O our Lord, forgive us, forgive us, forgive us, forgive us!
(Mawlana Shaykh sings.)
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani ‘r-rajeem.
Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmani ‘r-Raheem.
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, `Azeez Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Kareem Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Subhaan Allah
Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Allah Allah, Sultan Allah
Dome dome, dome dome, dome dome, dome dome 4x
Allah.
(43 minutes)
Forty-three and you are free!
Fatihah.
Lefke, 08.01.2010 after Isha
